build.ci: never -- this corpus is scored with torch and transformers, which are not runtime dependencies of this build
build.export_command: uv run --with pyarrow --with torch --with transformers python3 tools/export_typed_decisions.py --parquet all/test-00000-of-00001.parquet --out typed-decisions-export.jsonl
build.export_stage: stage 1, documented in tools/build_typed_decisions.py and deliberately outside CI

clamp.affects: the `choice` question type at key `11+`, one entry of the checkpoint's own temperature table
clamp.disclosed_by: the scoring run's load-time warning, quoted in the certificate document
clamp.stated: confidence on the affected entries is not calibrated
clamp.warning: this checkpoint ships an illegal `choice:11+` temperature, which upstream's loader clamps to 0.5 at load time, so confidence on affected entries is not calibrated

export.note: the scoring export is not a committed file: it is stage 1's output, and this digest is what the build layer refuses a mismatch on. The committed bytes are `records.path`; their own identity is pinned beside them.

fetch.note: huggingface.co answered this endpoint with a valid chain on 2026-10-24; an earlier probe on 2026-10-09 recorded the dataset as absent locally and the host as intercepted. The difference is an environment fact, not a code change.
fetch.tls: verified, no bypass, no --insecure, no proxy bypass

main_revision.fact: all five typed-decisions files are absent from the cached `main` revision
main_revision.use_instead: the hub id must not be used for this measurement; `source.revision_used` is the revision that was scored
